Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: geometry | ID: 47985

Theorem

Consider the smooth equation on a Bergman space M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the Schatten operator \(S_{01290011}\) acting on the Paley-Wiener space. By the Schatten decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01290011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01290011\).

Step 2. By the irrational spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01290012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the irrational spectral family.

Step 3. By the trace-free spectral theorem, we decompose \(U_{01290013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the trace-free spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via variational interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
